data.name: Vincenty
data.gender_notes: Vincenty is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Vincentius, meaning 'conqueror'. The name Vincent was borne by many early Christian saints, including St. Vincent of Saragossa, who was known for his miraculous healings and protection of the city of Saragossa from the Romans. The name Vincenty carries the meaning “Conqueror of cities” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vincenty usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror of cities and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vincenty total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
